name: io.github.nvdigitalsolutions/nvoos-mcp-gateway
title: NV oOS Gateway
description: Streamable HTTP MCP gateway exposing your NV oOS fleet — self-mutating REST APIs — behind one API key, with per-tool quotas, declarative policy rules, W3C trace propagation, and a fleet audit sink.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Gateway API key issued by NV Digital Solutions, bound to one or more site slugs. Send as "Authorization: Bearer <key>".

capabilities.quotas: per-tool token buckets scoped key × site × tool, RFC 9558 RateLimit-* headers, 429 + -32099 on breach
capabilities.policy: declarative allow/deny/require_approval rules over tool/site/key/time(tz)/geo, first-match-wins, tools/list catalog filtering, 403 + -32001 / 428 + -32002
capabilities.trace: W3C traceparent start-or-inherit, propagated upstream and stamped on every log line
capabilities.audit: optional HMAC-SHA256 fleet audit webhook (deny / quota_exceeded / require_approval / call_ok, arguments never included)
capabilities.admin: operator-token GET /admin/policy, POST /admin/policy-sim replay against the recorded-call ring buffer, dryRun mode, SHADOW_POLICY log-only evaluation
